evidence: The MoNx thin films were deposited on a 3D NF substrate in a showerhead-type ALD reactor (Lucida-M100, NCD Technology) at a deposition temperature of 225 °C. A precursor pulsing of 10 s and a purge with 200 sccm of Ar for 10 s prior to a reactant pulsing were set. After reactant pulsing, another purge step was performed for 10 s prior to the follow-up precursor pulsing.
